Pawniard

Dark Steel

Unova · Generation 5

Pawniard is a Dark/Steel-type Sharp Blade Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 10.2 kg. It evolves into Bisharp. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 340.
